6. submit with your report.

Budget: at most 40 tool calls in total (every call counts, including hypothesis and submit calls), 15 minutes, and each tool output is cut at 20 KB. Each tool result ends with a line showing your remaining budget. If you run out before submitting, the run fails with no result, so leave enough calls to verify and submit. Efficiency: each reply you send uses one request from a small daily allowance, so do not spend a reply on a single call when several are independent.
